title: H5b: ensure_worktree reuses an existing task branch and spawn_scout reports spawn errors; dispatch re-spawns queued review and spec_review tasks whose worker died; handover snapshot rewritten only when goal state changed
spec:
Build on goal/T-0353 after H6 (T-0359) and H8 (T-0360) so daemon.py and spawn.py rebase cleanly. Evidence (gotchas 2026-09-19 23:18 and 2026-09-20 12:40): review T-0332 was requeued by reconcile_dead with reason "process died; requeued" and never ran again because daemon.dispatch iterates queued execute tasks only; spawn_scout(T-0354) answered "spawned" three times while ensure_worktree (spawn.py:60-71) failed on git worktree add -b for a branch left by an earlier dead spawn; handover.write runs every 15 minutes and rewrote plan.md 6 times on 2026-09-19 without state changes.
1. spawn.ensure_worktree: when wt/<id> is missing but branch task/<id> exists, run git worktree add wt/<id> task/<id> (no -b); when the worktree exists but is not registered (stale), git worktree prune first. Errors propagate: mcp.spawn_scout, spawn_review and spawn_spec_review reply {status: error, reason} instead of "spawned" when the spawn thread fails before the claim, and the failure is logged as a run row with outcome spawn_error.
2. daemon.dispatch: after the execute loop, re-spawn queued review and spec_review tasks whose pipeline is empty and whose events show a "process died" requeue (or that were never claimed for longer than [daemon].respawn_after_s, default 120), respecting free Claude worker slots; stamp respawned_at in pipeline to do it once per requeue.
3. handover.write: compute a snapshot hash over the goal state it renders (task ids, statuses, hold reasons, merged_into); rewrite plan.md only when the hash differs from the last written one (kept in handover_state.json); the daemon still ticks every 15 minutes but an unchanged state produces no write and no commit churn.
Tests: tests/test_spawn.py::test_ensure_worktree_reuses_existing_task_branch; tests/test_mcp.py::test_spawn_scout_reports_error_when_worktree_fails; tests/test_daemon.py::test_dispatch_respawns_requeued_review_once, ::test_dispatch_respawns_unclaimed_spec_review_after_delay; tests/test_handover.py::test_unchanged_state_writes_nothing. Keep every existing test green; .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0; git add -A and commit with the task id; report sha and failures only.
acceptance: Existing tests pass; .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0 in the worktree
